chunks.rationale: ThreadView.tsx ChangesPanel (~2527-2624): the itinerary, chunk file lists, .patchScroll, and truncated note now live in one <div className={styles.changesScroll}>. .commitBox stays a direct sibling after that wrapper (still inside the fragment; header stays outside). This is the structural half of #555 — the tall itinerary can no longer push the only commit surface past the clipped panel edge.
risks: If a later change nests .commitBox inside .changesScroll, sticky will attach to the scroller and the box will scroll away again — same user-visible bug.
Error/loading/empty nodes remain siblings of the fragment (unchanged). An inline error shown next to a loaded tall itinerary still consumes flex space above the scroller.

chunks.rationale: ThreadView.module.css: new .changesScroll is the only flex:1 / overflow-y:auto child. .patchScroll lost flex:1 and overflow:auto so it no longer fights for space or nests a second scroller. .changesHead and .commitBox get flex-shrink:0. .commitBox is position:sticky; bottom:0 with background:var(--bg-elevated) so it stays painted at the panel's padding edge (sticky ancestor is .changesPanel, overflow:hidden — intentional).
risks: A long diff no longer has its own inner scrollbar; itinerary + file lists + patches share one scroll. .fileList still has max-height:120px overflow-y:auto, so nested scroll remains on file lists only.

sticky is redundant with the flex layout (commit box is already a non-shrinking sibling after the scroller) but matches the contract; the opaque background still matters if overlap ever paints through.
.commitInput is resize:vertical — a user-stretched textarea can eat review space. Pre-existing, now more visible because the box cannot be clipped away.

Layout-only; not verified in a running Electron window. jsdom tests cannot assert computed overflow/clip. Confidence is from the flex contract: header and commit box cannot shrink, the middle is the only scroller, panel still overflow:hidden.
Parallel worker owns test/threadView.test.tsx — this branch does not add the new class-name assertions those tests will look for.
